title: A Survey on Trustworthy Recommender Systems
measurement_description: The paper does not measure or evaluate faith or religion. It is a comprehensive survey on trustworthy recommender systems and only mentions religion briefly as an example of a sensitive or protected attribute in the context of fairness, bias, and discrimination.
findings: There are no specific findings related to religion. Religion is only noted theoretically as a protected attribute that recommender systems should avoid discriminating against when ensuring algorithmic fairness.
